guide.title: TV guide

empty.body: Add an M3U / Xtream / HDHomeRun source with an XMLTV guide and the programme grid fills in.

guide.help: Use the arrow keys to move between programmes: left and right change the time, up and down change the channel. Page Up and Page Down jump ten channels. Press Enter for details.

recordings.noneScheduled: Nothing scheduled. Open the guide and pick a programme to record.
recordings.noRules: No series rules. Use “Record series” in the guide.
recordings.keepLast: {count, plural, one {Keeps the last episode} other {Keeps the last # episodes}}

empty.title: No recordings
empty.body: Record a programme from the guide or the player. Recordings are saved on your MixAI Server exactly as broadcast.

confirm.cancelBody: “{title}” will not be recorded. Anything already captured is kept as a partial file.
confirm.deleteBody: “{title}” and its file on the MixAI Server are deleted for good.
confirm.ruleBody: New episodes of “{title}” stop being recorded. Existing recordings stay.

recordings.notInLibrary: The recordings folder is not a library folder on the MixAI Server, so the file cannot be streamed. Add a “recordings” folder in the server settings.
recordings.unsupported: This browser cannot play this recording.
